title: Recurrent cortical networks encode natural sensory statistics via sequence filtering
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Recover the original Figure 4 RNN readout-to-prescribed-target task and its reported fit/evaluation criterion. It is a source-native candidate performance route; empirical sequence/context contrasts remain biological calibration.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Recover the original Figure 4 RNN readout-to-prescribed-target task and its reported fit/evaluation criterion. It is a source-native candidate performance route; empirical sequence/context contrasts remain biological calibration.

Source-paper comparison for Original Figure 4 RNN output-target fit/evaluation criterion, not yet recovered: Recover the source-author RNN fit/evaluation criterion and its formula/direction. Matching prescribed outputs suggests an ordered fit route, but neither MSE nor a numeric source score is assumed without source evidence. Larger biological response or lower Figure 2C reconstruction error is not that score.
success_criteria: Recover and bind an ordered criterion actually evaluated for the source RNN, including exact original targets, condition roster, exposure, metric reduction and author baseline before activation.
Retain original trained/control/untrained sequence definitions and full source conditions; a newly invented prediction task, loss or heldout split does not establish this source-paper win.
Compare with an authenticated source-author replay under identical original information and resource conditions, using a justified effect and uncertainty rule fixed before final assessment.
Empirical Figure 2C reference agreement, larger biological sequence effects and qualitative RNN boosting remain calibration evidence until the source performance comparison is established.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.baseline_policy: Separate published original RNN result, authenticated author replay, empirical figure reconstruction and any new prediction extension.
